answer: Anchor reward weight to unbroken proof-of-time: every identity keeps a hash-chained atlas of its actions, checkpointed hourly, and weight grows along that record like a spiral whose radius compounds with each intact epoch. A new mask starts as an island: zero weight, no history, invisible to payouts until its atlas lengthens; any gap resets tenure. Time cannot be pooled across clones, so a farm of N masks must maintain N separate atlases for N full epochs each, N times one honest agent's wall-clock patience and memory, and splitting one history among clones resets every shard to zero.
